com.esignal.jstandard.event

Interface HistoricalTickListener


  • public interface HistoricalTickListener
    The main purpose of this interface is to allow customers to write custom code to process HistoricalBars of intraday data, HistoricalTickRecord of tick data, HistoricalTickRecordCID of tick CID data objects and FlexData of Flex tick and bar data.

    The client implemented listener should also listen to requested, error and complete events. The clients should be process these methods as fast as possible, otherwise it could impact the latency of delivering data to their application.

    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    ICE Data Services
    See Also:
    HistoricalTickEvent, HistoricalTickFlexEvent

      • onIntradayResponse

        void onIntradayResponse(HistoricalTickEvent<HistoricalBar> historicalTickEvent)
        Callback method triggered to signify that a HistoricalTickEvent, related to an Intraday request, is available for processing. The event object contains a list of HistoricalBar objects. These can be accessed via HistoricalTickEvent.getHistoricalTickList().
        Parameters:
        historicalTickEvent - HistoricalTickEvent object which wraps information about HistoricalBar.
        See Also:
        HistoricalTickEvent, IntradayHistoricalBar

      • onIntradayFlexResponse

        void onIntradayFlexResponse(HistoricalTickFlexEvent historicalTickFlexEvent)
        Callback method triggered to signify that a HistoricalTickFlexEvent, related to an Intraday request, is available for processing. The event object contains a JSON schema, the payload (of Flex data) and a iterator to traverse over the records and fields in the payload. This can be accessed via getSchema, getByteBuffer, and the iterator method of the event.
        Parameters:
        historicalTickFlexEvent - HistoricalTickFlexEvent object which wraps information about the FlexData.
        Since:
        01-024-0000
        See Also:
        HistoricalTickFlexEvent, FlexData, FlexDataField
